bagPolicy.summary: Only clutches, wallets, wristlets, and crossbody bags that meet the dimensions of 4.5” x 6.5” are permitted inside Desert Diamond Arena. Diaper bags are allowed with a child and must enter through specific gates.
bagPolicy.note: Guests requiring ADA or medical accommodations should contact Guest Services. Sensory bags are available for checkout at no cost.

parking.note: Parking is available in multiple lots including G, J, L, Yellow, Garage, and VIP lots. Pre-paid parking offers expedited entry and is available until 30 minutes after the event starts. Payment is by credit/debit card only, no cash accepted.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Desert Diamond Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Desert Diamond Arena offers gourmet food and beverage options, including chef-crafted cuisine and premium cocktails, as part of their premium experiences. Guests can enjoy an exceptional culinary experience with a selection of beer, wine, sodas, and water. First-class catering is available for an additional cost.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Assistive listening devices are available to check out at the Guest Services Booth located near Section 115. Sensory bags containing KCVIP badges, fidget tools, noise canceling headphones and other resources, are available for checkout (at no cost by leaving an ID) at our Guest Services Booth located at Section 115.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Desert Diamond Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Desert Diamond Arena Box Office is located on the Northeast corner of the venue between Gate 4 (main gate) and Gate 5. The Box Office is closed on non-event days and is open three hours prior to show time for all events.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Desert Diamond Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
